user.title: Sign in to SiiPet
user.description: Choose how to sign in to your SiiPet account.

menu_options.email: Sign in with an email code

email.title: Sign in with an email code
email.description: Enter the email address of your SiiPet account. SiiPet sends a sign-in code to this address.

code.title: Enter the code
code.description: Enter the code that SiiPet sent to {email}.

token.title: Paste an access token
token.description: Copy both values from a request of the SiiPet app. The access token is the part after `Bearer` in the `authorization` header. The device identifier is the `x-device-identifier` header.

reauth.title: Sign in to SiiPet again
reauth.description: The SiiPet session ended. Choose how to sign in again.

menu_options.email: Sign in with an email code

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to SiiPet. Try again later.
error.code_request_failed: SiiPet did not send a code. Check the email address and try again.
error.invalid_code: The code is not correct or it expired.
error.invalid_device_identifier: Paste the value of the x-device-identifier header.
error.invalid_token: This is not a SiiPet access token. Copy the complete value after Bearer.
error.login_failed: SiiPet rejected the sign-in. Go back and request a new code.
error.session_rejected: SiiPet accepted the code, but rejected the new session. Request a new code and try again.
error.token_rejected: SiiPet rejected the token. Copy a current token and its device identifier from the SiiPet app.
error.too_many_requests: SiiPet allows only a few code requests per day. Try again tomorrow, or paste an access token.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Read the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This SiiPet account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same SiiPet account as before.
